Part 2 · summary

What Part 2 settled

  • Skirts and floors are set by suction head and gravity flow of cakes.
  • NPSH available 13–15 m on all five pumps.
  • Each isometric carries its own BOM from the same coordinates.

Key Takeaways

1

Lay out in process order along the rack; keep people far from hydrocarbons.

2

Every platform needs two ways out; layout finds what the P&ID cannot.

3

Elevations come from the process: suction head, gravity flow.

4

Isometrics turn coordinates into a bill of material.

5

One coordinate file keeps drawings and the 3-D plant in step.
